name: be-mastery-android
description: BE Mastery — Android app shell (Capacitor) around the web app in the repository root. Replaces the Play TWA; see docs/ANDROID_NATIVE_SHELL_PLAN.md.

scripts.sync: node ../ios/scripts/sync-web.mjs --out www --platform android && npx cap sync android
scripts.sync:staging: node ../ios/scripts/sync-web.mjs --out www --platform android --staging && npx cap sync android
